name: Linden Summer Day Camp
operator_name: City of Linden Department of Parks & Recreation
description_short: Seven week city day camp for Linden residents entering kindergarten through grade 8, held at city parks and schools by grade group, with a teen camp for grades 7 and 8. Families choose a package with or without five trips.
notes: Open only to Linden residents. General camp 8 am to 5 pm; teen camp 9 am to 4 pm. Packages for the seven weeks: Standard $500 (no trips; trips can be paid separately), Silver $705 (five trips), Gold $755 (five trips with lunch on trips); payment plans available. Sites: Kiddie Camp (entering K) at School #4; Al Kalla Day Camp at School #10, Highland Ave, and McGillvary Day Camp at McGillvary Park (grades 1 and 2); Tremley Day Camp at Memorial Park, Tremley Point Rd (grades 3 and 4); McManus Day Camp at McManus Park (grades 5 and 6); Wilson Teen Camp at Wilson Park (grades 7 and 8). 2026 registration deadline was May 15. Ages derived from grades.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. City news post: 2026 camp for Linden residents entering K to 8, June 29 to August 14, 2026, general camp 8 to 5, teen camp 9 to 4. Ages derived from grades.
